description:
Preview or write a deterministic SwiftUI feature scaffold.

Default approved=false is non-mutating and returns every planned path and file body: Memi iOS spec, SwiftUI view, optional screen model, preview, and Swift Testing file.
Set approved=true only after reviewing the plan. Writes never alter Xcode project files and refuse to overwrite existing files.

approved.description: Must be true to write. false returns a complete dry-run plan.

atomicLevel.description: Atomic Design level for component scaffolds; screens are always page.

deploymentTarget.description: Minimum iOS deployment target in major.minor form.

intent.description: Product and design intent recorded in the generated spec.

kind.description: screen creates model + view + test; component creates view + test.

liquidGlass.description: Add an iOS 26+ glassEffect branch with a native material fallback.

moduleName.description: Swift module imported by the generated @testable test target.

name.description: PascalCase feature or component type name, such as Settings or CommandBar.

name: scaffold_swiftui_files
